title: Simulador Oficial Completo TOEIC® - Versión 8
description: Simulador completo real de Listening & Reading enfocado en Horizon Enterprise y el líder the Client Services VP.

parts.visual:
## 📝 Simulador Oficial TOEIC® (Versión 8)

Evaluación de **Listening & Reading** en tiempo real:

1. **Listening Section**: Evalúa tu comprensión en Horizon Enterprise usando EliteCRM.
2. **Reading Section**: Mide tu análisis gramatical de memorandos emitidos por the Client Services VP.

*Inicia tu prueba simulada oficial.*
parts.audio: Welcome to the Full TOEIC Simulation. Manage your time efficiently across both listening and reading stages. Let's begin.

questions.question: [PART 1 - PHOTO]: Select the best description of Horizon Enterprise's office photo.
questions.audio_script: A) They are answering calls at the service center. B) They are sorting client refund claims. C) The customer care division is closed. D) They are training new support executives.
questions.explanation: Se observa a los agentes de atención al cliente con diademas atendiendo llamadas de soporte en vivo.

questions.question: [PART 3 - CONVERSATION]: Listen to the dialogue and answer: What does the man agree to do next?
questions.audio_script:
M: Hi James, did Horizon Enterprise send the new SLA terms?
W: Yes. The Client Services VP wants all client satisfaction rates logged under EliteCRM.
M: Perfect, let's make sure our support team is fully aligned.
options: Sign the contract as currently written.
Call the manager to negotiate an extension of the delivery window.
Write a new memorandum to sales staff.
questions.correct_answer: Call the manager to negotiate an extension of the delivery window.
questions.explanation: El hombre dice: 'I will call their manager to negotiate an extension'.

questions.question:
[PART 5]: Complete the business sentence correctly:

"All employees are strictly required to comply ___ the updated security rules in EliteCRM."
questions.explanation: El verbo 'comply' rige gramaticalmente la preposición 'with' (comply with / cumplir con).

questions.question:
[PART 7]: Read the memorandum and answer: **When will the migration to EliteCRM officially occur?**

**MEMORANDUM**

*To:* Support Supervisors
*From:* Client Services
*Subject: SLA Protocol & EliteCRM Training*

Please note that starting next Friday, all customer incident tickets must be logged in EliteCRM. A review session will take place this next Friday at 8:00 AM in Conference Room 302.
questions.explanation: El memorando dice: 'starting next next Friday, we are officially retiring our legacy sales tool and migrating to EliteCRM'.
